Files moved in the editor (workspace/willRenameFiles): the inherit
statements, #includes and object paths that name a moved file are
edited before the move, each as it was written, in documents open (for
their version) and files not open (for no version); a moved file's own
#include that names a file beside it is edited too. A path made by a
macro is not changed, and the user is told. A folder moves with its
files.

-- lib/dgdtools.yml --
root: .
driver_config: mud.dgd
-- lib/mud.dgd --
include_dirs = ({ "/include" });
-- lib/include/std.h --
#define ROOM "/std/room"
-- lib/std/room.h --
#define LIGHT 1
-- lib/std/room.c --
#include "room.h"
int light;
-- lib/obj/a.c --
inherit "/std/room";
void f() { clone_object("/std/room"); }
-- lib/obj/b.c --
#include <std.h>
inherit ROOM;
-- lib/obj/c.c --
#include "/std/room.h"
-- script --
initialize lib
open lib/obj/a.c
move lib/std/room.c lib/domain/room.c
received window/showMessage
move lib/std lib/base
text lib/obj/a.c
shutdown
exit
